result.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
result.comment: Euan Ong and Jiahai Feng advised equally
result.summary: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out SAE features. It also identifies concepts behind steering vectors about as well as NLAs, recovers the payloads of LoRA backdoors more often than corpus search, and can even verbalise some model workspace inner monologue. Unlike explanations produced by other metamodels (e.g. NLAs), MAEM exemplars can be verified with a forward pass on the subject model, making the MAEM objective a grounded alternative for scaling the training of metamodels.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MAEM：用无标签的 RL 目标训练语言模型，把 subject model 的残差流方向反演成能强激活该方向的文本示例，使 activation inversion 可扩展到任意方向；在 Qwen 上优于语料检索与 NLA，能激活多数 held-out SAE 特征、识别 steering vector 概念、恢复 LoRA 后门载荷，且示例可用 subject model 前向传播验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本的「残差流方向→可验证文本」反演工具，可能可供核查 VLM 内部 latent 状态是否真的承载视觉证据与实体关系线索；其用前向传播验证解释、以激活相似度作为 grounded 目标的思路，或可借鉴到 LVR 中 latent 内容贡献分配与停止决策的评估，跨模态迁移效果待核查。
